Agents

Build narrow agents for narrow jobs.

A general coworker does most things. Some channels want an agent with one brief and a short reach. Build it in Slack in a minute.

One brief, one channel, your rules

Give it instructions, pick a model, decide when it speaks and which apps it may reach, and name who approves. It is created in the channel it works in and edited there too.

Three jobs worth their own agent

A help channel that answers itself and routes the rest to a person. A contractor channel with an agent that reaches only what that channel needs. A shared channel where an agent answers your customers in your voice, with your staff approving anything that leaves.
